caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cupboard-like piece of furniture composed of two main sections stacked vertically. The entire structure is rendered in a reddish-brown wood tone. The upper section is taller and features two doors, each containing six rectangular panels with pierced metal inserts that have a decorative, repetitive punched pattern, showing as grayish areas. The lower section is wider and deeper, with two shorter doors, each containing four rectangular panels, also with pierced metal inserts matching those of the upper section. The cupboard stands on four straight, tapered legs, and the overall form is rectangular with simple molding details at the top of each section. The background is plain and beige, and there is a small inscription in the lower right corner stating "GEO. V. VEZOLLES."
title: Shaker Tin Safe
